numbers/bigrational#

Canonical exact ratio: positive denominator, gcd=1, unique zero 0/1.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let third = BigRational(numerator: 1, denominator: 3);
third.plus(third).string();    // "2/3"
third.divided(third).string(); // "1/1"

Description#

Canonical exact ratio: positive denominator, gcd=1, unique zero 0/1.

Public API#

object BigRational#

object BigRational does Comparing<BigRational>

An exact fraction of two ints, always reduced: 2/4 is 1/2.

BigRational.BigRational#

BigRational(numerator is int, denominator is int)

The ratio is reduced here, so equal ratios have equal fields and compare equal.
